text.arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَبِمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا بِهِۦ رُسُلَنَا ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural relative pronoun resuming a known group and awaiting its defining clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) opens with a definite relative head rather than a fresh noun, so the group remains tied to the disputers just observed in 40:69. The word leaves identity grammatically unfinished until the denial verb arrives, making falsification the defining predicate before the warning is stated. The discourse therefore moves from witnessed disputation into third-person classification without resetting the actors.

topics.headline: known group resumed by relative form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is continuing with the same tracked disputers from 40:69 rather than introducing a new group.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is appositional to the prior discourse and opens a relative topic whose predicate follows in the consequence clause.

topics.headline: identity waits for denial clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the group named by its falsifying action before any punishment or consequence is named.
topics.reason: The relative head has no independent noun and is completed by the following denial clause.

topics.headline: witness frame becomes verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary shift from direct observation in 40:69 to a charged third-person classification in 40:70.
topics.reason: Boundary evidence supports continuity of the same group while the new relative opening converts observation into accusation.

words.gloss_range: Form II completed falsification directed through two bi-marked object domains
words.root_gloss_range: falsehood, lying, and declaring false; locally selected as Form II pronouncing revelation false
words.prose: {{ar:كَذَّبُوا۟}} ({{tr:kadhdhabū}}) is not a bare state of doubt or simple lying; Form II makes the group actively pronounce the Book and the sent content false. Its plural ending keeps the relative head as the actor, while the perfect aspect fixes that verdict before the ayah delays its reversal into future knowledge. Across the boundary from 40:69, the verb names the active falsification behind the earlier question of being turned away. The root's falsehood field is aimed at revelation itself, so the deniers treat the fixed Book and messenger-borne mission as though they occupied the place of false report; this also places them in the surah's repeated messenger-denial pattern (40:5) and in the broader messenger-denial frame (3:184).

topics.headline: Form II governs two denial domains
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees denial as a completed accusatory act aimed at two governed domains, not as vague unbelief.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence gives the verb two bi-marked object complements and no bare direct object.

topics.headline: falsehood field becomes declared falsification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the form changing the falsehood root into an act of labeling revelation false.
topics.reason: The broader root includes lying, but the local Form II and governed objects select declaring something false.

topics.headline: completed denial before future recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one plural group carried from a settled false verdict into promised future knowledge.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect 3mp and the closing knowledge verb is the later imperfect under the future particle.

topics.headline: messenger-denial field returns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this denial is part of a recurring messenger-rejection pattern, especially within the same surah (40:5).
topics.reason: The supplied recurrence and co-occurrence rows connect the local denial with messenger language without overriding the local syntax.

topics.headline: diversion is explained by denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 40:70 name the active deed behind the diversion questioned in 40:69.
topics.reason: The boundary row supplies a concrete discourse handoff from passive diversion to active falsification.

words.gloss_range: first object-marking preposition governing the Book under the denial verb
words.prose: The first {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) makes the Book a governed target of falsification, not an instrument used for denial. Its scope closes at the Book before the conjunction opens another object, so the first object has its own syntactic footing. At the same time, it starts the repeated prepositional frame that will widen the single denial across the Book and the sent content.

topics.headline: Book marked as denial target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Book as the accused object of falsification, not as a tool or circumstance of denial.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the definite Book as the first complement of the denial verb.

topics.headline: first half of repeated object frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the syntax widen from one governed object to a second without changing the governing verb.
topics.reason: The first preposition closes before the conjunction, and the second object repeats the same prepositional marking.

topics.headline: prefixed form displays attachment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Book enters the phrase already bound to the denial construction.
topics.reason: The bundle splits the prefixed preposition as its own word while preserving its orthographic attachment to the noun phrase.

words.gloss_range: the definite Book as a governed object-domain of denial, with scripture, record, and binding authority in range
words.root_gloss_range: writing, recording, joining, prescribing, and decreeing; locally gathered in the authoritative Book as fixed revealed record
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}) is definite, singular, and genitive under the first object-marking preposition, so the denial targets a recognized authority rather than anonymous writing. The {{ar:ك ت ب}} ({{tr:k-t-b}}) field lets record, scripture, prescription, and decree press together: what is denied is fixed and binding, not a negotiable report. Placed before the relative sending clause, the Book supplies the durable-record side of revelation, while the messengers supply mobile mission; the same surah has already established this Book frame (40:2; 40:53), and the contrast with guidance language in 2:2 makes the reversal sharper.

topics.headline: recognized Book under denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees denial aimed at an identifiable authoritative Book, not at writing in general.
topics.reason: The noun is definite singular and genitive as the governed complement of the preposition.

topics.headline: fixed record and binding authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Book carries both written evidence and binding authority into the object of denial.
topics.reason: The broad root range is allowed as pressure, while the local noun selects the authoritative Book rather than every possible writing branch.

topics.headline: one stabilized authority object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the form gather revealed authority into one stable object before the sentence broadens to the mission clause.
topics.reason: The definite singular nominal form supports a stabilized object of record and authority.

topics.headline: fixed record beside sent mission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices revelation framed as both durable record and messenger-carried mission under one act of denial.
topics.reason: The local syntax coordinates the Book with the relative clause about what was sent with the messengers.

topics.headline: surah Book frame reversed into denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the familiar Book of guidance turned here into the object of falsification, with local surah recurrence supporting the weight of the term (40:2; 40:53; 2:2).
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows supply concrete references and do not conflict with the local governed-object role.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining a second bi-marked object-domain to the first
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the denial clause open after the Book and adds a second governed object-domain without starting a new accusation. Because the next word renews the preposition, the conjunction builds a balanced expansion: one act of falsification now reaches both fixed scripture and what was sent with the messengers. Its prefixed surface makes addition and renewed governance arrive together.

topics.headline: second object added under one verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sentence expands one denial act rather than beginning another accusation.
topics.reason: The conjunction joins two bi-marked complements governed by the same denial verb.

topics.headline: scope widens without sequencing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the charge widen in scope to messenger-borne content without implying a later separate denial.
topics.reason: The conjunction carries additive coordination, not temporal sequencing, and the repeated preposition preserves parallel object status.

topics.headline: surface bundle renews governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices addition and object-marking fused at the point where the second target begins.
topics.reason: The conjunction is prefixed to the following preposition in the surface bundle.

words.gloss_range: second object-marking preposition governing the relative pronoun and its sending clause
words.prose: The second {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) restarts governance after the conjunction and gives the relative pronoun its own object status under the denial verb. Its scope is not a single named noun but the whole clause defined by sending with the messengers. The repeated preposition also begins a chain with the later payload pronoun, tying denial, content, and dispatch through one relational pattern.

topics.headline: relative content gets its own object slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the messenger-borne content as a parallel target of denial, not as a loose appendix.
topics.reason: The second preposition governs the relative pronoun as a separate complement of the denial verb.

topics.headline: preposition scopes over clause-defined content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied object opens as a small governed unit and unfolds into the whole sending clause.
topics.reason: The relative clause completes the governed pronoun and defines the object domain.

topics.headline: prepositional chain links denial and dispatch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated particle-family tying the denial's objects to the mission's payload.
topics.reason: The three bi-forms occur in linked local functions: Book object, relative object, and payload complement.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun for the second denied object, completed by the following sending clause
words.prose: {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) is a governed relative object whose content is not named immediately. It keeps the second target both definite by relation and open in range: what is denied is whatever the following sending clause identifies as carried through the messengers. The small form therefore becomes a hinge, delaying specification until dispatch, payload, and envoys have unfolded.

topics.headline: object completed by sending clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader waits with the grammar until the sending clause defines the second object of denial.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is governed by the second preposition and completed by the embedded relative clause.

topics.headline: open content defined by transmission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not enumerate propositions but lets the whole messenger-borne content field be denied.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun keeps the object open while the local clause defines its authorized transmission route.

topics.headline: small pronoun expands into mission phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a compact relative word expand into the full dispatch-payload-messenger construction.
topics.reason: The form is relative, not demonstrative, and is syntactically expandable by the following clause.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect dispatch by the divine speaker, governing messengers as object and the payload pronoun as complement
words.root_gloss_range: sending, release, dispatch, message, and commissioned mission; locally selected as authorized divine sending
words.prose: {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}) defines the second denied object by dispatch: the content is what the divine speaker sent with messengers. Form IV and the attached subject keep agency explicit, while the verb's valency binds sender, payload, and envoys into one mission event. The {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) field contributes outward movement, but local grammar disciplines that movement into commissioned revelation; same-surah recurrence at 40:23 and 40:78 makes the clause part of an ongoing messenger history, here turned into the object of denial.

topics.headline: sender agency stays explicit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the mission sourced in the speaker's completed action rather than in anonymous transmission.
topics.reason: The verb is active Form IV perfect with first-person plural subject marking.

topics.headline: dispatch binds payload and envoys
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that denial of the content cannot be separated from denial of the authorized mission structure.
topics.reason: The verb governs the messenger noun as direct object and the payload pronoun as prepositional complement inside the relative clause.

topics.headline: release image narrowed to commissioned mission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the root's outward movement realized as authorized dispatch through appointed carriers.
topics.reason: The root range includes release and sending, but Form IV with object and complement selects commissioned dispatch.

topics.headline: sending clause joins surah mission history
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this sending clause as one node in the surah's repeated mission pattern, especially 40:23 and 40:78.
topics.reason: The supplied same-surah recurrence rows support mission-history resonance without changing the local parse.

topics.headline: sending verb echoed by messenger noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the messengers as the embodied result of the sending action within the same clause.
topics.reason: The verb and object share the same root and are syntactically paired.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus anaphoric suffix marking the payload/accompaniment of the sending clause
words.prose: {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) shifts the preposition from denial-object marking to accompaniment under the sending verb. The attached pronoun resumes the relative content, compressing the payload into a small form before the messengers are named. Its range allows with, by, or through it, but local grammar keeps those values tied to the introduced content; placed before the messenger noun, the word foregrounds what is carried before the carriers themselves.

topics.headline: preposition belongs to the sending verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the preposition shift from object-marking to payload accompaniment inside the dispatch clause.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the phrase a complement of the sending verb, with the suffix resuming the relative content.

topics.headline: medium and payload overlap locally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one compact pronoun can carry payload, accompaniment, and authorization pressure without multiplying nouns.
topics.reason: The bi-range supports medium and accompaniment, while local anaphora narrows the reference to the relative content rather than an unrelated object.

topics.headline: payload named before envoys
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the carried content foregrounded before the envoys, keeping the denied payload central.
topics.reason: The preposition-plus-suffix compactly resumes the content and precedes the messenger noun.

topics.headline: third preposition completes local chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same prepositional family link denial's targets to the mission's carried content.
topics.reason: The word is the third local bi-form after the Book object and relative object markers.

words.gloss_range: plural possessed messenger noun as direct object of the sending verb
words.root_gloss_range: messenger, envoy, sent one, mission-bearing representative; locally plural envoys possessed by the divine speaker

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: Form IV sending verb echoed by the messenger noun
accepted syncopated reading preserving the messenger noun's grammar while tightening cadence

words.prose: {{ar:رُسُلَنَا ۖ}} ({{tr:rusulanā}}) closes the embedded sending clause by naming the envoys as the direct object of the dispatch. The suffix binds them to the same speaker who sent them, so their authority derives from possession and commissioning rather than autonomous speech. As proof-bearing messengers, they also make the denied content something the deniers will later have to recognize, with the excuse-removing messenger frame of 4:165 in the background. The plural gathers a class of missions under one source, while the root echo with {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}) turns action into agents; the cadence variant {{ar:رُسْلَنَا}} ({{tr:ruslanā}}) preserves that grammar while tightening the movement before the consequence particle.

topics.headline: Our messengers as sent object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the envoys' authority grounded in being sent and possessed by the speaker.
topics.reason: The noun is the direct object of the sending verb and bears a first-person plural possessive suffix.

topics.headline: messengers defined by delegated mission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rejecting what they carry rejects representation from the sender, not merely private claims by individuals.
topics.reason: The r-s-l range supports sentness and mission, while local possession and object role specify authorized envoys.

topics.headline: many envoys gathered under one sender
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denial generalized across messenger missions while the source remains singularly marked by the possessive suffix.
topics.reason: The noun combines plural messenger form with first-person plural possession.

topics.headline: messenger field meets future recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices messenger-borne content as the very field denial will later be forced to recognize, with proof-language resonance from 4:165.
topics.reason: The supplied inter-ayah and co-occurrence rows support messenger-proof pressure without altering the local object role.

topics.headline: envoys named after payload
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the clause foreground the carried content before naming the envoys who embody the dispatch.
topics.reason: The payload complement precedes the direct object, and the messenger noun closes the relative clause.

topics.headline: dispatch becomes audible in envoys
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the messenger noun answer the sending verb, while the accepted cadence variant tightens the transition before the threat.
topics.reason: The verb and noun repeat the same root, and the variant preserves syntax while altering cadence.

words.gloss_range: consequence particle pivoting from the relative accusation into the outcome clause
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns the long relative description into an outcome: the future knowing is a consequence of denial, not an unrelated later fact. Because it meets the future particle before the verb, the discourse pivots immediately while the realization remains delayed. The surface bundle makes accusation become forecast in a compact closure.

topics.headline: relative accusation receives outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the relative description become a result-clause rather than a static label.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the closing clause as the consequent predicate after the relative topic.

topics.headline: knowledge caused by denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the promised knowledge causally attached to the preceding falsification.
topics.reason: The particle links the outcome clause to the prior denial description.

topics.headline: fast link meets delayed realization
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices consequence and postponement held together at the start of the closing warning.
topics.reason: The consequence particle is prefixed immediately before the independent future particle.

words.gloss_range: independent future particle scoping over the closing imperfect knowledge verb
words.prose: {{ar:سَوْفَ}} ({{tr:sawfa}}) delays only the coming knowledge, not the completed denial behind it. As an independent particle rather than a shorter prefix, it creates a full pre-verbal beat before the objectless closing verb. The warning therefore has temporal distance without losing grammatical certainty, and it participates in the deferred-recognition rebuke formula heard in 102:3-4 while 40:69 to 40:70 shifts from direct observation to impersonal verdict.

topics.headline: future particle scopes over knowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the recognition delayed while the denial remains a completed prior act.
topics.reason: The particle governs the following imperfect knowledge verb and does not reach back over the denial clause.

topics.headline: separate future marker gives spacing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the warning spaced out before the verb rather than compressed into a shorter future prefix.
topics.reason: The form is an independent future particle preceding the full imperfect verb.

topics.headline: future particle prepares open recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels expectation gather before an objectless verb that leaves the recognition field open.
topics.reason: The future particle stands between the consequence particle and the objectless closing verb.

topics.headline: rebuke formula of delayed knowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the future-knowledge warning as part of a deferred-recognition rebuke pattern (102:3-4).
topics.reason: The supplied echo gives a concrete formula reference and the local wording fits the warning pattern.

topics.headline: observation shifts to verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices 40:69's direct observation giving way to a future verdict over the deniers in 40:70.
topics.reason: The boundary row supplies a concrete discourse shift between 40:69 and 40:70.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect active knowing under future scope, with no overt object
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, recognizing, discerning, and firm apprehension; locally future active recognition by the deniers
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamūn}}) is the endpoint of the consequence-and-future bundle. Its plural ending carries the same deniers into the closing verb, while the imperfect under the future particle makes knowledge a coming realization. Because the verb has no overt object, the ayah closes on recognition itself: the denied Book, sent content, consequence, and exposure all fill the open space. The active Form I makes the endpoint their own unavoidable knowing rather than being informed by someone else, and the {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}) field reverses the earlier falsification field; the echo with 54:26 sharpens exposure while the local ellipsis widens what will be known. The deferred-knowing rebuke pattern of 102:3-4 and the heavy final plural cadence together make the closure feel delayed, rounded, and unavoidable.

topics.headline: closing verb receives fa-sawfa scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the whole consequence-and-future movement funneled into one closing act of knowing.
topics.reason: The verb is the imperfect governed by the future particle and terminates the closing clause.

topics.headline: same plural group must know
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the very subjects who completed denial are the ones carried into future recognition.
topics.reason: The 3mp ending resumes the relative head and matches the plural denial verb.

topics.headline: object omitted so recognition stays open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the whole denied complex gather into an unnamed object of future knowledge.
topics.reason: The verb has no overt object in the local frame, and translation support marks the object as omitted until later discourse.

topics.headline: active knowing, not being informed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices recognition becoming their own state rather than an external act of teaching or informing.
topics.reason: The local form is active Form I; contrasts with passive or causative forms are useful only to clarify the selected form.

topics.headline: knowledge answers falsification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the lexical reversal: what they placed under falsity is routed into firm knowledge.
topics.reason: The local sequence pairs denial and knowledge as semantic opposites across the ayah.

topics.headline: exposure echo widened by omitted object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an exposure pattern like 54:26 and a deferred-knowing formula like 102:3-4, while 40:70 keeps the object wider.
topics.reason: The supplied inter-ayah rows give concrete references; the local objectless verb prevents narrowing the object only to the 54:26 formulation.

topics.headline: warning lands as delayed closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's structure and cadence enact a move from completed denial to unnamed but unavoidable recognition.
topics.reason: The boundary and cadence rows support the structural reversal without adding a new lexical sense.

baseline_models.mechanism: The deniers actively assign falsehood to the book and to what was sent with the messengers; the deferred knowledge clause places that verdict under a coming reversal.

activation_trace.role: Attributing a thing or its bearer to falsehood supplies the deniers' active counter-verdict.
The written record supplies the first object placed under that counter-verdict.
Carried speech and its carriers supply the second, transmitted object of rejection.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the coming reversal of their present verdict.

changed_reading.before: They simply fail to believe a message.
changed_reading.after: They issue a counter-verdict against both record and transmission, but the verse marks that verdict as provisional before a later disclosure.

baseline_models.mechanism: The book can be heard as an assembled record, while the doubled dispatch root exposes act, carried content, and carriers as a transmission system rather than unrelated nouns.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another supplies the assembled coherence of the record.
Sending and releasing supply the outward movement of the transmission.
Messenger and message supply the carriers and carried speech within that movement.

changed_reading.before: The book and the messengers are two adjacent rejected objects.
changed_reading.after: The focus presents an assembled record together with a visible dispatch network, so rejection attacks a joined system of preservation and delivery.

baseline_models.mechanism: The future construction delays but does not specify the object, timing, or mode of disclosure, leaving the deniers' present epistemic posture open to later displacement.

activation_trace.role: A thing becoming disclosed to its knower supplies the still-unspecified future event.

changed_reading.before: They will eventually receive some information.
changed_reading.after: Their current certainty is suspended before a promised disclosure whose content and mode the focus verse deliberately leaves unstated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's first matching rejection scene turns falsehood attribution into an operation: false material is used to make truth lose its footing, while truth is characterized by stability.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood attribution anchors the revised mechanism in the focus act of rejection.
Claiming what has no reality supplies the material deployed in the dispute.
A foot slipping and losing stability supplies the intended mechanical effect on truth.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies what the attempted dislodgement cannot finally remove.

structural_cues: 40:5 repeats takdhib and a messenger before sequencing dispute with falsehood, attempted dislodgement of truth, and seizure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rejection, false material, a slipping image, and stable truth; I supply the arrow that takdhib is the verdict powering an attempted dislodgement. The acts could alternatively be parallel offenses rather than one operation.

changed_reading.before: Takdhib is a wrong proposition about revelation.
changed_reading.after: Takdhib becomes a campaign to deprive truth of traction, and 'they will know' announces the failure of that operation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The believing man's conditional argument makes liar-attribution a risk-bearing judgment: if the messenger lies, the lie returns upon him, but if he is truthful, promised consequence can reach the hearers.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsehood anchors the categorical judgment made by the focus group.
Repeated liar-attribution supplies the conditional case and locates the burden of a lie.
Truth verified in fulfilled word or deed supplies the live opposing possibility.
Threatening promise supplies the consequence that makes a mistaken verdict costly.

structural_cues: 40:28 explicitly balances 'if he is a liar' against 'if he is truthful' before warning that some promised consequence may strike.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the conditional alternatives and their asymmetric consequences; I infer that the categorical takdhib of 40:70 chooses one side of that earlier risk. The speech may also be prudential rhetoric without defining every later rejecter's psychology.

changed_reading.before: The deniers confidently classify the messengers as false.
changed_reading.after: They make a high-stakes attribution after the surah has already exposed its live countercase, so future knowledge is also settlement of an assumed epistemic risk.

context_deltas.mechanism: Descent as delivery, inheritance of a book, selective narration of earlier messengers, and permission governing signs turn the focus conjunction into a distributed but authorized archive.

activation_trace.role: Joining parts supplies the focus record's assembled coherence.
Messenger and carried message supply the human transmission layer.
Causing something to descend and reach its recipient supplies authorized delivery at the surah's opening.
Knowledge or book passing as inheritance supplies preservation across communities and time.
Sequentially carrying a report supplies the narrated portion of a messenger history that also includes unnarrated members.
Permission and authorization supply the limit on a messenger's production of a sign.

structural_cues: 40:2 opens with delivery of the book, 40:53 transfers the book as inheritance, and 40:78 includes both narrated and unnarrated messengers whose signs require permission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, inheritance, partial narration, and authorization; I infer a single distributed archival mechanism connecting book and messenger transmission. The focus conjunction may instead keep the book and other sent content more sharply distinct.

changed_reading.before: The book and sent material are merely two items on a list.
changed_reading.after: They are layers of a delivered, inherited, selectively narrated, and authorized transmission history, so the rejection reaches beyond one local encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Future remembrance of prior speech and the closing challenge about signs already shown make the focus knowledge a compelled recognition of available evidence, not necessarily first exposure to information.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower anchors the focus event whose novelty is being revised.
Bringing something back after or alongside retention supplies future recollection of an already spoken warning.
Causing signs to be seen supplies prior presentation rather than absent data.
The opposite of recognition and acknowledgment supplies the hearers' present refusal toward what has been shown.

structural_cues: The future form in 40:44 parallels the focus future form, while 40:81 asks which already shown signs can still be denied.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies future remembrance, prior showing, and failed recognition; I infer that later knowing can be re-cognition rather than new data. The remembrance statement may address a narrower audience than 40:70.

changed_reading.before: They will know because evidence is currently unavailable.
changed_reading.after: They will know by being forced to recognize and remember evidence already delivered but presently denied.

context_deltas.mechanism: The free outward dispatch carried by the focus root is immediately answered by collars, linked restraints, and dragging: rejecters of released carriers become constrained objects of conveyance.

activation_trace.role: Sending, setting in motion, and releasing supply the messengers' free outward conveyance.
A collar that binds a limb supplies bodily restraint opposite the focus release.
Connected links and parts supply the mechanism that transmits restraint along the body.
Dragging and extending an object supplies forced conveyance in place of voluntary response.

structural_cues: 40:71 follows the focus verse immediately and replaces the sending of messengers with the bound movement of the deniers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release in the focus branch and restraint plus dragging next; I supply the reversal from rejected conveyance to forced conveyance. The following scene may simply describe punishment without intentionally echoing dispatch.

changed_reading.before: They reject content that arrived through sent carriers.
changed_reading.after: Their rejection of freely dispatched carriers is answered by their own constrained transport, so future knowing begins as something bodily undergone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The interrogation after the focus reverses the direction of negation: those who invalidated revelation report their own invoked objects lost, then reduce their former calling to 'nothing.'

activation_trace.role: Assigning falsehood anchors the first direction of invalidation against revelation.
Disclosure anchors the moment at which the direction of invalidation can reverse.
Loss of the sought object supplies the disappearance of what they had treated as valid.
Calling and verbally drawing an object near supplies their denied former relation to those objects.
A knowable, reportable thing supplies the category they negate when saying they called nothing.

structural_cues: 40:73 asks where the associated objects are; 40:74 moves from 'they are lost from us' to 'we did not call anything before.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an initial verdict against revelation and a later loss-plus-nothing response about their own objects; I infer a rebound of invalidation. Their later words could instead be evasive denial rather than sincere revised knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Future knowledge merely proves their first judgment false.
changed_reading.after: Future knowledge reverses the target of negation: revelation survives their verdict, while their own invoked objects become lost and verbally collapse into nothing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit alternative between being shown part of the promise and dying before return keeps the focus future open in timing; the closing scene then shows consequence-driven acknowledgment arriving without benefit.

activation_trace.role: Future disclosure anchors the event whose timing and efficacy the context specifies.
A threatening promise supplies the future content that may be partly manifested.
Causing something to be seen supplies the worldly partial-visibility branch of the alternative.
Taking the soul in full supplies death before visible completion as the other branch.
Return to what preceded supplies the common destination beyond either temporal branch.
Direct sight supplies the consequence-driven acknowledgment at the surah's close.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the pragmatic value explicitly denied to that late acknowledgment.

structural_cues: 40:77 states an either-or between partial showing and death followed by return; 40:84-85 then pairs seeing the consequence with belief that no longer benefits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the temporal alternatives, later sight, and non-benefit; I infer that they delimit the open sawfa of 40:70. The immediate 40:71 scene may begin fulfillment earlier than the final closing pattern.

changed_reading.before: They will learn at one unspecified later moment.
changed_reading.after: Disclosure may begin through partial worldly sight or await return after death, and knowledge attained only through witnessed consequence can be true yet no longer beneficial.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's final messenger scene says the rejecters already rejoice in knowledge held 'with them'; their mockery is then enclosed by its object, so focus knowledge displaces a proprietary knowledge regime rather than filling a blank.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure anchors the promised epistemic change.
Exultant, insolent joy supplies the affective reward attached to their possessed knowledge.
Something disclosed to and possessed by a knower supplies the rival knowledge in which they rejoice.
Harm descending and enclosing supplies the reversal that overtakes their epistemic enclosure.
Mockery supplies the dismissive practice sustained by that self-satisfied knowledge.

structural_cues: 40:83 repeats messengers and clear signs, then sequences joy in possessed knowledge, enclosing consequence, and prior mockery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies messengers, signs, possessed knowledge, joy, mockery, and enclosing consequence; I infer a rival knowledge regime overturned by the focus future disclosure. Their knowledge may be partial or misapplied rather than wholly false.

changed_reading.before: Ignorant deniers will move from no knowledge to knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Self-satisfied possessors of a rival knowledge will undergo a disclosure that exposes the limits and affective insulation of what they already claim to know.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps the non-writing 'joining' branch of the book root onto literal chain links. It remains anchored to الْكِتَاب through the packet's joining image and to 40:71 through connected links immediately after the focus. Render only as a material echo, not as a claim that 'book' means chain or that the punishment is a lexical decoding of the book.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another supplies an assembled coherence latent in the focus book.
Connected rings and parts supply a dark material counterpart to that assembled coherence.
A collar binding the body supplies the coercive function taken on by the linked assembly.

changed_reading.before: The rejected book is only a written object.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, rejection of an assembled record is followed by an imposed assembly of links, turning refused textual coherence into bodily constraint.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the zoological branch in which a creature runs and then stops to look behind, far from the ordinary falsehood sense. It remains anchored to كَذَّبُوا and is activated by the surah's doubled travel-look-outcome sequence. Downstream prose should call it a branch-based motion analogy, never a lexical gloss of takdhib.

activation_trace.role: Running for a stretch and then stopping to inspect what lies behind supplies an interrupted-motion image for denial.
Travel and forward motion supply the run-like first phase of the analogy.
Directing sight or insight supplies the commanded stop-and-look phase.
The end and aftermath of a thing supply what the backward look discovers.
The repeated travel command reinforces the forward-motion phase near the surah's close.
The repeated look command reinforces retrospective inspection rather than uninterrupted flight.
The repeated aftermath supplies the terminal evidence that arrests the denial-run.

changed_reading.before: Takdhib is a static attribution of falsehood.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also a denial-run that appears mobile but is repeatedly arrested by a compelled look at the aftermath behind it.

strongest_changes: The promised knowledge overturns a self-satisfied rival knowledge rather than merely filling ignorance.
The book and messenger material becomes a delivered, inherited, selectively narrated, and authorized archive.
The immediate sequence reverses free messenger dispatch into the deniers' constrained transport.
The future remains open between partial worldly sight and return after death, while consequence-driven acknowledgment can arrive too late to benefit.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made remote epistemic scenes decisive: 40:28 exposes the risk in liar-attribution, 40:77 calibrates the open future, and 40:83-85 recasts knowing as the overthrow of insulated knowledge and as potentially non-beneficial recognition. The immediate 40:70-71 motion reversal and the doubled travel-look-outcome sequence also preserved branch-level material readings that a local paraphrase would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The conjunction may distinguish the book from other sent content more sharply than the distributed-archive model allows.
The free-dispatch versus forced-transport reversal may be a reader-supplied material analogy rather than an intended rhetorical link.
The future knowing may begin in the bodily sequence of 40:71 or culminate only in the sight and confession of 40:84-85.
The knowledge possessed in 40:83 may be genuine but partial, misapplied, or itself false; the packet does not force one diagnosis.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Rejected assembly will become unavoidable knowledge.** `ك ت ب/B001` gives joined structure, `ر س ل/B001` sending forth, `ك ذ ب/B001` falsehood against truth, and `ع ل م/B001` knowledge. I infer that denying both message and transmission does not disassemble their coherence; future knowing reads as enforced recognition of a structure that remained joined despite denial.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The bodily restraint of 40:71–72 makes “they will know” experiential, while 40:78 clarifies that decisive knowledge arrives with authorized judgment.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Rejected communication remains available as an executing inscription.** Lexically, `ك ت ب:B002` is joined writing and book, while `B003` is inscription as binding decree or judgment; `ر س ل:B002` supplies messenger and message. Structurally, 40:68 has just joined decision to immediate execution, 40:69 identifies diversion from signs, and 40:71-72 realizes collars, dragging, hot water, and fire after `فسوف يعلمون`. The book's communicative role has been refused, but its binding role persists. The packet gives denial -> future knowing -> enacted consequence; I infer that knowledge arrives when the inscription's judgment-function executes. The book therefore cannot be neutralized by refusing its message-mode.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 40:78 joins messenger dispatch to decisive ruling, and 40:83 again rejects clear demonstrations; these confirm the book's dual message-and-judgment persistence.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın anlam çekirdeğini verir; kişi betimleyen türevler ile özürlere ilişkin kalıp yalnız kendi sözcüksel karşılıklarında gösterilir ve yalın anlama eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir sözün veya davranışın doğruluğa aykırı olmasıdır. Bu niteliği taşıyan kişi, yalan söyleyen ya da yalanı çokça tekrarlayan biri olarak betimlenebilir.

facets.statement: Doğruluğa aykırılık hem söylenen bir sözde hem de yapılan bir davranışta gerçekleşebilir.
Bu niteliği taşıyan veya onu sıkça gösteren kişi, yalan söyleyen kişi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, doğruluğa aykırılığı ortak çekirdek sayar; kullanım alanını söz ve davranış olarak verir ve bu niteliği taşıyan kişiye yönelik adlandırmaları aynı anlam çevresinde toplar.

root_profile.summary: Kökün anlam ağı, söz ve davranışta doğruluğa aykırılık ile başkasını yalan sayma çekirdeğinden; yükümlülük, savaş hamlesi, gecikmeme, süt kesilmesi, hayvan hareketi, iç benlik ve kumaş görünüşü gibi sözlüksel olarak özelleşmiş alanlara uzanır. Bu alanların bir bölümü yalan veya beklentinin boşa çıkması düşüncesiyle ilişkilendirilebilirken bir bölümü bağımsızlaşmış adlandırmalar olarak kalır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, anlam çekirdeğini bir şeyi başka bir şeye katıp birleştirmek olarak açıkça kurar; deri dikme, hayvanın bazı uzuvlarını bağlama, boncukla tutturma ve birlik oluşturma kullanımları da bu çekirdeğin özelleşmiş gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yazı yazma ya da hüküm verme anlamını değil, fiziksel veya toplu birleştirme işlemini kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak birleştirme çekirdeğini korur; dikme, bağlama, kapatma ve birlik düzenleme anlamlarını yalnızca tanıklanmış biçim ve yapılara bağlı özelleşmeler olarak verir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeye katıp aralarında fiziksel ya da topluluk oluşturan bir bağ kurmaktır. Derileri dikme, açıklıkları bağlama veya kapatma ve insan ya da atları düzenli bir birlik hâline getirme bunun yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyi başka bir şeye katarak ikisini bir bütün veya bağlı bir düzen içinde birleştirmektir.
Deri parçalarını ya da bir su tulumunu dikişle birleştirmek, çekirdeğin el işi alanındaki özel gerçekleşmesidir.
Bir hayvanın belirli uzuvlarını halka, kayış veya iple birbirine bağlamak ve bir kabın ağzını sıkıca kapatmak yapıya bağlı kullanımlardır.
Atların veya askerlerin toplanıp ayrı ve düzenli bir birlik oluşturması, fiziksel birleştirmeden topluluk düzenine uzanan anlamdır.
Kayışın iki yüzünü bir arada tutan boncuk, ortaya çıkan bağın somut bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, katma ve birleştirme çekirdeğinin dikiş, bağlama, sıkıca kapatma ve düzenli topluluk oluşturma gibi somut uygulamalarda korunmasıdır.

concept_map.definition: Harfleri çizgiyle düzenleyerek yazılı bir metin oluşturmak ve bu işlemin ürünü olan metin ya da yazılı sayfadır. Birine yazdırma, ondan yazmasını isteme ve yazmayı öğretme ise belirli yapılara bağlı uzantılardır.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, harfleri yazıyla düzenleyip bir metin oluşturmak veya var olan metni kopyalamaktır.
İşlemin ürünü, yazılmış metin veya üzerinde bu metnin bulunduğu sayfa ya da kitaptır.
Bir metni başkasına söyleyerek yazdırmak ve birinden kendisi için yazmasını istemek yapıya bağlı ettirgen ve isteme kullanımlarıdır.
Yazmayı öğretmek, yazı öğretmeni ve öğretim yeri anlamları yazı edinimi alanındaki bağlı kullanımlardır.
Öğretim yerindeki çocuklar veya onların topluluğu için kullanılan biçim, yeri değil öğrencileri gösterir.

facets.statement: Kişinin adını bir kayıt veya listeye geçirerek ona kayıtlı kişi konumu vermek dalın çekirdeğidir.
Adı pay, geçim tahsisatı veya yönetim siciline yazdırmak resmî kayıt alanındaki özel gerçekleşmedir.
Bir kişiyi tanıklar gibi belirli bir topluluğun içinde saymak, sicile almadan üyelik vermeye uzanan kullanımdır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, her türlü yazılı sözleşmeyi değil, bedelin ödenmesiyle özgürlüğe götüren bu özel sözleşme türünü kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım özel sözleşme türüne bağlı kalır; sözleşmenin adı, tarafı ve sözleşme yapma eylemi ayrı tanıklanmış biçimler olarak korunur ve genel sözleşme anlamına genişletilmez.

facets.statement: Sahip ile köleleştirilmiş kişi arasında, kişinin kendi özgürlük bedelini ödemesini konu alan özel bir sözleşme kurulur.
Bedel belirlenmiş ödeme dilimlerine bağlanır ve köleleştirilmiş kişi bunu kendi kazancından karşılar.
Kararlaştırılan bedelin tamamlanması sözleşmenin sonucu olarak köleleştirilmiş kişinin özgür olmasını sağlar.
İlgili biçimler sözleşmenin kendisini, sözleşmeye bağlı köleleştirilmiş kişiyi ve bağlama göre sözleşmenin öteki tarafını gösterebilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dalı yaratılmışların bütünü, gök düzeni ve içindekiler ya da yaratıkların ayrı sınıfları olarak açıklar. Her sınıfın ve bütünün yaratıcıyı gösteren bir belirti sayılması adlandırmanın gerekçesidir; bilme eylemi veya somut işaret dalıyla özdeş değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yaratılmış varlıkların bütünü veya sınıflarıyla sınırlıdır; bilme durumu ve bağımsız bir fiziksel işaret anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, çıplak dalın evren, yaratılmışların bütünü ve varlık sınıfları anlamlarını verir; başka kuruluşlardan anlam aktarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yaratılmış olanların bütünü; bağlama göre evren ile içindekilerin tamamı veya yaratıkların ayrı ayrı sınıflarıdır. Bu bütünün yaratıcıyı gösteren bir belirti sayılması, adın açıklanan dayanağıdır.

facets.statement: Evren ve içindeki yaratılmış varlıkların tamamı tek bir bütün olarak adlandırılır.
Ad, yaratılmışların tamamı yanında onların her bir cinsini veya sınıfını ayrı bir bütün olarak da gösterebilir.
Yaratılmış bütünün kendi yaratıcısına gösterge olması, adlandırmanın açıklayıcı dayanağı olarak sunulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu adı yaratılmışların bütünü için kullanır; kapsam bazen evren ve içindekilerin tamamı, bazen de yaratıkların her bir cinsi veya sınıfıdır. Bütünün kendi yaratıcısına işaret etmesi adlandırmayı açıklayan ortak bir düşüncedir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yaratılmış varlıkların tümünü tek bir düzen veya bütün olarak anlatan temel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Evreni ve onun içindeki yaratılmışların bütününü birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün bütün evren yerine insan, görünmeyen varlıklar veya başka bir yaratık cinsi gibi ayrı sınıflara dağıtıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Her yaratık cinsinin ayrı bir bütün sayılması yönünü korur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların çoğu hayvan bedenindeki renk ve işaretleri ya da ilgisiz özel adları anlatır; aynı kökün bilme ve işaret dalları adlandırma gerekçesini açıklasa da bu dalın yaratılmışlar bütünü sınırını keskinleştirecek bir karşıtlık oluşturmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı açıkça üst dudaktaki yarıkla sınırlar; insanın üst dudağının yarılmış olması, devenin üst dudak bölgesindeki aynı belirti ve üst dudağı yarma eylemi bu kimliği doğrular. Genel yarılma anlamı veya alt dudaktaki bir biçim bozukluğu bu dala dahil değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Belirti özellikle üst dudakta bulunur; genel çatlaklar, alt dudak ve ağız çevresindeki başka eğrilikler kapsam dışıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Üst dudak yarığı dalın temelidir; yarıklı kişi veya deve nitelemesi ile üst dudağı yarma eylemi ilgili biçimlere bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: İnsanın üst dudağında veya devenin üst dudak bölgesinde bulunan belirgin yarıktır. Aynı dal, bu özelliği taşıyanı niteleyen biçimi ve üst dudağı yarma eylemini de kapsar.

facets.statement: Üst dudakta bulunan yarık, dalın anatomik çekirdeğini oluşturur.
Üst dudağı yarık insan veya üst dudak bölgesinde bu belirti bulunan deve, özelliği taşıyan varlık olarak nitelenir.
Birinin üst dudağını yarmak, anatomik sonucun oluşturulmasını bildiren eylemsel kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yarığın yerini üst dudak olarak ortak biçimde sınırlar ve yarıklı insanı bu özellikle niteler. Toplu tanıklık, devenin üst dudak bölgesindeki karşılığını ve üst dudağı yarma eylemini de aynı dalda gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan veya devenin üst dudak bölgesindeki belirgin yarığı adlandıran temel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yarığın türünü ve özellikle üst dudaktaki yerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanı veya deveyi üst dudak bölgesindeki yarıkla niteleyen bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Özelliğin taşıyıcıda bulunmasını ve anatomik yerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin üst dudağında yarık oluşturma eylemini anlatan kuruluşta kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylemi, etkilenen kişiyi ve üst dudak sınırını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yer ve sonuç bakımından üst dudağa özelleşmiş anatomik bir addır; komşu dal ise nesne ve yüzey türü bakımından geniş bir yarılma eylemidir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal yüz ve ağız çevresindeki belirgin bir yapısal özelliği adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir su birikimi türü tanımlamaz; aynı sözlük biçimi için deniz ve suyu bol kuyu olmak üzere iki ayrı karşılık verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak geçici çerçevedeki ortak su kütlesi görüntüsü yerine bu açık seçeneklilik tanıma yazılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Deniz ile suyu bol kuyu tek bir ara nesnede birleştirilmez; bunlar aynı biçimin kaynaklarda verilen iki ayrı sözlük karşılığıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak sözlük biçiminin deniz ve suyu bol kuyu karşılıklarını ayrı ayrı korur; bunlardan genel bir su birikintisi anlamı türetmez.

concept_map.definition: Aynı sözlük biçiminin bir kullanımda denizi, başka bir kullanımda ise suyu bol kuyuyu adlandırmasıdır. İki karşılık, genel bir su birikintisi anlamında kaynaştırılmaz.

facets.statement: Dal, aynı adın iki ayrı su varlığına verilen sözlük karşılıklarını birlikte kaydeder.
Bir kaynak karşılığında ad, geniş tuzlu su kütlesi olan denizi gösterir.
Diğer ve daha yaygın kaynak karşılığında ad, suyu çok olan kuyuyu gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık iki karşılığı yan yana verir: bir aktarım sözcüğü deniz olarak açıklar, öteki tanıklıklar ise suyu bol kuyu anlamını destekler. Kaynaklara özgü ayrı claim kimlikleri bulunmadığı için bu karşıtlık ortak özet içinde, atıf uydurulmadan korunur.

concept_gloss.text: deniz ya da suyu bol kuyu

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtüşme yalnızca deniz karşılığındadır; odak dalın kuyu seçeneği komşuda bulunmaz, komşunun büyük ırmak ve genel su genişliği ise odak dalın tanımına girmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kuyunun kendisini suyunun bol olması koşuluyla adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kuyudaki kovadan dökülen veya havuza taşan suyu, kokusunu ve taşma olayını anlatır.
